policy: Publisher description and language preserved from the released plugin.json; introductory README excerpt used only if publish.description is absent. README formatting-only removal is recorded. Existing workbook provenance is not altered.

sources.originalExcerpt: **PlayTime Tracker** es un plugin para [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader) que registra el tiempo de juego en SteamOS y muestra estadísticas desde el menú de acceso rápido de Steam.
Can't decide what to play from your massive Steam backlog? Let **Backlog Picker** choose for you!
> Ultimate Steam Deck optimization plugin for Decky Loader
**Decky plugin that brings universal RGB LED control to handheld gaming consoles running SteamOS, Armada OS, or Bazzite.**

This is a Decky Loader plugin that lets you stream **NTS 1** and **NTS 2** directly from the Steam Deck sidebar, with live show metadata and artwork — no external players, no browser, no backend services.
A scanmem wrapper in a [decky-loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader) plugin.

**ControllerPriority** is a Decky Loader plugin for the Steam Deck that automatically manages your controller order. It ensures that an external controller (like a PS5, Xbox, or Switch Pro controller) is always recognized as **Player 1** by hiding the internal Steam Deck controller the moment an external one is connected.

eGPU Game Config Swap is a Decky Loader plugin for SteamOS. A game can need different graphics settings when an eGPU dock is connected and when it is disconnected, but the game keeps the same configuration after the GPU changes. This plugin stores an "eGPU" profile and an "Internal" profile for each registered game, then lets you switch profiles with one button.
Creates Steam collections based on ProtonDB compatibility tiers and optionally syncs them to Tab Master.

YomiDeck is a Decky Loader plugin for Steam Deck that captures in-game screenshots and wirelessly synchronizes them to the [YomiLLM](https://github.com/m1kuk1m/YomiLLM) Android application for real-time Japanese text recognition (OCR), furigana annotation, sentence grammar breakdown, and AI-powered dialogue parsing.

Decky plugin for [ArmadaOS](https://github.com/armada-os/armada) that installs
Armada onto the internal disk from the SD-card installer environment, and that
can also create an Armada game library in the Linux reserve partition of a TF
card while keeping the Android storage on that card. Both modes work without a Steam account, a game
library or a sign-in, and neither writes to a disk the user did not confirm.
A [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader) plugin for the Steam Deck that lets you toggle SSH on and off directly from the Quick Access Menu.
Plugin de Decky Loader para control de curvas de ventilador en la **ROG Ally Z1 Extreme**.

A [Decky Loader](https://decky.xyz) plugin for the Steam Deck that lets you wake it from sleep by pressing the home button on any paired Bluetooth controller — just like an Xbox or PlayStation console.
**Claude Code on your Steam machine, controlled from your phone — built to debug Steam without leaving Gaming Mode.**

A [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader) plugin for the **AYN Thor** on **Armada OS** that holds the battery at **80 %** while plugged in, to slow battery wear. Named for the thin ribbon that bound Fenrir: a small thing that restrains a large force.

A [Decky Loader](https://github.com/SteamDeckHomebrew/decky-loader) plugin and virtual input driver for the **AYN Thor** (dual-screen handheld, Armada OS). It turns the lower 3.92" AMOLED screen into a **trackpad**, a **keyboard**, a **split** of both, or a **quick-settings and hardware monitor** for games on the main screen, with no launcher in the way.
A touch control pad for the AYN Thor's bottom screen, built for World of Warcraft, Final Fantasy XI and other MMOs. Named after Járngreipr, Thor's iron gloves.
